name: EFC External Research Watchlist
description: Delta-scan of external cosmology datasets and theory preprints that impact Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC). Used to route new evidence into the Validation Ledger, Stage-IV Data Roadmap, Gap Analysis, and Changelog.
bootstrap_note: First populated on 2026-04-17. Prior to this the delta-scan ran without a persistent SEEN set; all items below are initial entries, not deltas.

items.title: Dynamical dark energy in light of the DESI DR2 BAO measurements
items.efc_relevance: w0>-1, wa<0 preference in DR2 BAO sharpens the constraint that EFC must explain any apparent w(z) evolution via the perturbation sector, not background — directly engages the Background No-Go Theorem (three-pillar proof).
items.ledger_action: Add evidence-register row under Pillar-1 (background/LCDM) with status=support_nogo; cross-link to EFC_Background_NoGo_Theorem/ and bind to Stage-IV Roadmap milestone DESI-DR2.

items.title: DESI Reaches Mapping Milestone, Surpassing Expectations
items.efc_relevance: DESI on track for DR3 / 5-year cosmology release (2027). Confirms the timeline for which EFC must pre-register w(z) and f(z)σ8(z) curves.
items.ledger_action: Update EFC_Stage-IV_Data_Roadmap.html: mark DESI-DR3 milestone as on-schedule; freeze EFC DR3 prediction before release.

items.title: DES Year 6 Results: Cosmological Constraints from Galaxy Clustering and Weak Lensing
items.efc_relevance: S8 = 0.789 ± 0.012, Ωm = 0.333, with 1.8σ tension vs Planck+ACT-DR6+SPT-3G combined CMB. Directly tests the EFC-predicted 'DES Y6 vs KiDS-Legacy divergens som EFC-strukturprediksjon' entry already on the planned list. Low-side S8 is the sign predicted by entropy-geometry suppression.
items.ledger_action: Promote planned changelog entry to empirical/supported; add KT entry DES-Y6_S8 with observed vs EFC prediction; update Pillar-4 cross-probe statistics.

items.title: KiDS-Legacy: Cosmological constraints from cosmic shear with the complete Kilo-Degree Survey
items.efc_relevance: S8 = 0.81 ± 0.018, only 0.73σ from Planck — upward shift vs KiDS-1000. Creates a DES-Y6 (low) ↔ KiDS-Legacy (CMB-consistent) bifurcation. EFC must reproduce this bifurcation as a footprint-/zB-dependent shear response, not an average S8 shift.
items.ledger_action: Open new KT test (KT-shear-bifurcation): required EFC behaviour is footprint-dependent w4/w5 whitening component, not a global σ8 shift. Bind to existing 'Whitening WP4 komponent w5' planned entry.

items.title: Status of the S8 Tension: A 2026 Review of Probe Discrepancies
items.efc_relevance: New Combined-CMB baseline (Planck + ACT-DR6 + SPT-3G): S8 = 0.836 ± 0.013. Documents the DES-Y6 (2.4–2.7σ low) vs KiDS-Legacy (consistent) bifurcation. Provides an external, peer-style reference point for the EFC shear-bifurcation prediction.
items.ledger_action: Add to evidence-register as external review; cite in EFC_Validation_Ledger.html S8 section; use its Combined-CMB S8 as EFC's high-side reference and DES-Y6 as the low-side reference.

items.title: SPT-3G D1: CMB T and E-mode power spectra and cosmology (2019–2020 Main field)
items.efc_relevance: SPT-3G alone: H0 = 66.66 ± 0.60 (6.2σ from SH0ES). CMB+CMB combination: σ8 = 0.8137 ± 0.0037. 2.8σ LCDM tension between combined CMB and DESI-DR2 BAO drives preferences for modified recombination / electron-mass variation — alternative explanations EFC must either reproduce or rule out in its regime matrix.
items.ledger_action: Add regime-matrix row for modified-recombination/electron-mass escape hatch; document EFC's native prediction for σ8 and H0 as a standalone row in inference.json.

items.title: ACT DR6 final release (endings and beginnings)
items.efc_relevance: ACT DR6 is the final major ACT release — note that there is no DR7. DR6 CMB lensing: S8 = 0.818 ± 0.022 (alone), 0.813 ± 0.018 with Planck NPIPE. Establishes the Combined-CMB anchor used in the 2026 S8 review.
items.ledger_action: Correct internal references from 'ACT DR7' → 'ACT DR6 (final)'; update Stage-IV Data Roadmap timeline.

items.title: Simons Observatory Large Aperture Telescope achieves first light
items.efc_relevance: LAT now producing science data; UK-SATs first light expected within 2026. Pre-registration window for EFC CMB-lensing and delensing predictions closes as SO ramps up.
items.ledger_action: Add Stage-IV Roadmap milestone SO-LAT-Year1; open planned KT for EFC vs SO forecast cross-check.

items.title: A High-Caliber View of the Bullet Cluster via JWST Strong and Weak Lensing
items.efc_relevance: Highest-resolution mass reconstruction of 1E 0657-56 (146 strong-lensing constraints from 37 systems + dense weak lensing). Directly addresses the open gap 'Applying inference_cluster_tng to Bullet Cluster data should result in chi2 < 2.0'. Decisive for whether EFC's entropy-geometry reproduces the gas/galaxy offset without particulate DM.
items.ledger_action: Promote the Bullet-Cluster frontier-gap from NEEDS_REVIEW to ACTIVE with explicit input dataset = JWST high-caliber reconstruction; allocate pipeline run and freeze chi2<2.0 threshold.

items.title: A consistent MOND modelling of the Bullet Cluster
items.efc_relevance: Provides a same-dataset MOND benchmark against which EFC's entropy-sourced lensing can be compared head-to-head. Crucial because EFC's MOND-limit (AQUAL-like non-linear term) must not reduce to pure MOND in cluster regime.
items.ledger_action: Add to regime-matrix as external comparison row; ensure EFC Bullet-Cluster KT reports delta-chi2 vs this MOND baseline, not only vs LCDM.

items.title: BIG-SPARC: The new SPARC database (~4000 galaxies)
items.efc_relevance: 20× expansion of SPARC175 with HI datacubes from APERTIF/ASKAP/ATCA/GMRT/MeerKAT/VLA/WSRT + WISE NIR photometry. EFC's current Kill-Test v6 Universality result (60.2% win rate on SPARC175) is a 175-galaxy claim; BIG-SPARC turns it into a 4000-galaxy claim or falsifies it. This is the highest-leverage pending galactic test.
items.ledger_action: Open planned-pipeline row 'EFC vs BIG-SPARC universality'; freeze the 60.2% win-rate threshold before running on the full database; pre-register screening-model k = 0.415 with no per-galaxy tuning.

items.title: Informational Entropic Gravity (IEG): Gravity as Informational Symmetry from Entropy
items.efc_relevance: Independent construction that treats gravity as an equilibrium state of irreversible informational entropy on holographic boundaries. Formal neighbour to EFC's energy-functional + entropy-geometry approach; useful for cross-citation and for benchmarking distinct predictions (rotation curves, lensing).
items.ledger_action: Add to evidence-register as 'parallel framework'; open Gap Analysis row to list overlapping vs distinguishing predictions between EFC and IEG.

items.title: Entropic force in matrix (Matrix-theory derivation of emergent gravity)
items.efc_relevance: Shows the gravitational force law in BFSS-style matrix theory equals an entropic force from thermal fast/slow mode separation. Provides a microphysical underpinning of the class of theories EFC sits in and sharpens what 'entropy-sourced gravity' must look like at short scales.
items.ledger_action: Cite in EFC_White_Paper_Series theory-foundations section; add to evidence-register under theory/emergent-gravity.

items.title: Thermodynamic Gravity with Non-Extensive Horizon Entropy and Topological Calibration
items.efc_relevance: Introduces a Topological Calibration Principle (Gauss-Bonnet-based) to constrain deviations from extensivity in emergent-gravity settings. Directly overlaps with EFC's graph-topological entropy / area-law scaling diagnostics (efc_information_capacity_vs_S).
items.ledger_action: Open structural-constraints row: EFC must pass the topological calibration bound; check efc_information_capacity_vs_S.png data against its non-extensivity window.
